lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters are distributed across the mid-flank, forming a repetitive spatial arrangement between the longitudinal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear features of higher luminance intersect with the circular clusters, creating an orthogonal grid of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple linear features running horizontally along the superior lateral flank, characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with light upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface contains a high-density population of small-diameter high-luminance points, contrasting with the larger, more sparse blobs on the lateral trunk.
